== Biography ==
'''Master Walter de Glasgu''' witnessed Melrose charter material about 1291.<ref>''Liber Sancte Marie de Melros'', charter 353 and associated digital data; [https://archive.researchdata.leeds.ac.uk/574/ University of Leeds]; [https://www.poms.ac.uk/record/person/16434/ People of Medieval Scotland, person 16434].</ref>

The title `Master` indicates recognised advanced education or academic standing. The record supplies no office, parentage, property or further secure occurrence.

== Research Notes ==
One occurrence does not prove that `de Glasgu` was hereditary or connect Walter to another early bearer.
